{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm no QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
print(f'QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Confirm no refunded orders are in the converted group
refunded_mask = (df['status'] == 'refunded')
converted_and_refunded = (df['converted'] == 1) & refunded_mask
print(f'Converted but refunded orders: {converted_and_refunded.sum()}')

# Define the valid population: converted AND age not -1
valid_converted = (df['converted'] == 1) & (df['customer_age'] != -1)

# Compute mean age for valid converted customers
mean_age = df.loc[valid_converted, 'customer_age'].mean()
print(f'Mean age of converted customers (excluding age -1): {mean_age}')"}
